payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: Proposed by phase sase-11l.11.4 and already corroborated on ready task sase-10d: as of 2026-09-19 PyPI latest sase-core-rs remains 0.34.48 with wheels only and no sdist, while the hold repair APIs land in tagged core commits through v0.34.61 plus post-tag deadlock commit 0a7301c. tools/ratchet_core_window --report-only rejects the declared 0.34.48 floor as an incomplete release. This active epic's floor reconciliation must include the selector/capture/deadlock bindings before a SASE release ships.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: Proposed by sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4.1 note #1 and corroborated on ready task sase-10d. Landing sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4 removed the Python post_response_failure fallback and added tools/validate_sase_core_rs decide_gate_lifecycle(post_response_failure) coverage. PyPI latest sase-core-rs remains incomplete 0.34.48 (3 wheels, no sdist); 0.34.50 is unpublished; declared floor is still >=0.34.48. This epic's published-floor reconciliation must include the gate-decision lifecycle contract (post_response_failure on decide_gate_lifecycle) before a SASE release ships.
